message.content:
Here are a few well‑known documentaries that focus on global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change and its impacts. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to document the effects of climate change and explores solutions. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC documentary that explains the science behind global warming and its consequences. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from scientists, activists, and leaders. |
| **“Our Planet” (Season 1)** | 2019 | While primarily a nature series, it highlights how climate change threatens ecosystems worldwide. |
